settings.prior: model.from_unit (inverse normal CDF times prior sd; u clipped to [1e-300, 1 - 2**-53])

cdf_a_sup.note: sup |weighted CDF - reference CDF| of a over 801 points on [-4, 4]. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the value is +0.0079 +- 0.0007 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0030); this run ranks 1 of 20 by |value| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

cdf_b_sup.note: sup |weighted CDF - reference CDF| of b over 801 points on [-4, 4]. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the value is +0.0074 +- 0.0005 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0021); this run ranks 17 of 20 by |value| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

e_a2.note: E[a^2] from the weighted posterior versus quadrature. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the error is +0.0001 +- 0.0011 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0048); this run ranks 20 of 20 by |error| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

exploration_kept.note: Same run with discard_exploration=False (the setter recomputes the shell information). Exploration points can carry pseudo-importance bias; the trace's estimates use discard_exploration=True.

kish_ess.note: Kish 1/sum(wbar^2) of the exported posterior weights (samplingdemo.diagnostics.weight_ess). For Nautilus's estimator it equals sampler.n_eff algebraically, so agreement checks the exported weights; it measures weight concentration, not mode coverage.

likelihood_accounting.note: Every likelihood call is either stored by Nautilus or a dropped transfer candidate (n_like = stored + dropped).

log_z.note: sampler.log_z (discard_exploration=True) versus the quadrature reference. Nautilus 1.0.6 reports no evidence uncertainty. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the error is -0.0019 +- 0.0019 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0087); this run ranks 1 of 20 by |error| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

n_eff_nautilus.note: Nautilus's own shell-based effective sample size (sampler.n_eff); the run stops once it reaches the n_eff setting.

p_positive.note: P(a>0) from the weighted posterior; 0.5 by the sign symmetry of B. Over 20 seeds at this n_live the error is -0.0005 +- 0.0012 (mean +- SE; sd 0.0055); this run ranks 1 of 20 by |error| (1 = largest). See seed_ensemble.

seed_ensemble.note: Reference recovery over 20 independent seeds with this trace's settings and n_live (spec §14.3): per-seed errors against the quadrature reference (cdf_*_sup: sup CDF discrepancy), mean, sample sd, standard error and n. The displayed run is seed 1, fixed before any run (not selected for appearance) and the first ensemble member; displayed_rank counts the seeds whose |value| is at least the displayed run's (1 = most extreme).

uninstrumented_equivalence.note: A plain nautilus.Sampler run with the same settings and seed gave bitwise identical outputs.

label: Nautilus 1.0.6 — actual run (instrumented; outputs verified identical to an uninstrumented run)

streams.networks: sklearn MLPRegressor random_state = network index 0..n_networks-1 (MT19937), fixed by nautilus 1.0.6
streams.sampler: numpy.random.default_rng(seed) inside nautilus.Sampler (PCG64): unit-cube and bound sampling, GaussianMixture splits
streams.seed_ensemble: numpy.random.default_rng(seed) inside nautilus.Sampler for each seed in ensemble_seeds
